scope: Interpretation of existing logs only; no hardware rerun and no runtime change.
legacy_ui_counters: LUMA3D_UI_COST raster/compare_publish/scan_bytes/canvas_updates describe legacy mini_ui timings. Native puzzle/Simon modules have their own counters not printed by this main.
native_timing_zeros_mean: Not instrumented in those legacy fields; NOT absence of CPU UI work.
native_counter_evidence: l3_puzzle_ui.inc records cache->rasterized_pixels and cache->published_bytes; only r->mini_bytes/mini_uploads are forwarded
simon_presentation.c records p->ui_raster_pixels and p->ui_published_bytes; only r->mini_bytes/mini_uploads are forwarded
